about: Pointe-Claire is an independent West Island city on Lac Saint-Louis, on the Island of Montréal—not a borough of the city of Montréal. A stone windmill and a lakeside village mark the old point; post-war streets, Highway 20, and Fairview shopping fill the inland side. Stewart Hall and the municipal aquatic centre sit on the shore. About 33,000 people live in Pointe-Claire.
